notes.title: Little Nightmares 2 announced for 2020 release
notes.notes: A sequel to the creepy indie platformer, Little Nightmares, has been announced at Gamescom.The game looks like it will follow on from Six's escape at the end of the first game, and will see her join up with a new second character named Mono.Trailer footage shown during the Opening Night Live Gamescom stream is in engine, and shows the characters exploring the outside world and entering the Signal Tower, a main area the story will be set in.Read more

notes.title: Release date and Collector's Edition announced!
notes.notes:
Little Nightmares will release on April 28th!
In addition to this great news, we are glad to confirm the game will be available on Playstation 4, Xbox One and PC with digital editions but also with a limited physical ‘Six Edition’ (Check Availability details below).
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26237700/c96efaf9b0e8ba2df70c4183bda49d44d2ebfd50.jpg
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26237700/d5a67bafdc66a14885ca8b761d5357e9c07029bf.jpg

Preorders on Steam:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26237700/d3202982094c1bd71f737a9bc4b6d6174672efb1.jpg

You want more? Watch the new trailer:
English UK: 
https://youtu.be/IjTuW0uQhag
English US:
https://youtu.be/_JkdZOQomZc
English Australia: 
https://youtu.be/eYZxPfCkYJ4

Don't forget to pay a visit to escapekitchen.little-nightmares.com to try the interactive experience and register to get the exclusive (and free) DLC 'Tengu Mask' 

AVAILABILITY of 'Little Nightmares - Six Edition':
- Europe: PlayStation 4, Xbox One, PC
- North America: PlayStation 4, Xbox One
